in_sanskrit.name: Senu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Good, Wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Senu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Senu means good, wise. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'nidhi' meaning wisdom.

in_telugu.name: Senu
in_telugu.long_meaning: Senu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Senu means good, wise. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'nidhi' meaning wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Senu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Senu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Senu means good, wise. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'nidhi' meaning wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Senu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good, Wise
in_bengali.long_meaning: Senu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Senu means good, wise. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'nidhi' meaning wisdom.
